TestInteractiveStreamMultiTurnContinuity.reason: Requires current Claude semantic memory across three turns; sequential replay does not establish recall.

TestAuthenticatedHome_CredentialIsolatio.reason: Synthetic credential combinations and temporary operator HOMEs exercise fixture isolation; no actual provider process is called.

TestClaudeBinaryAvailable.reason: Installed-binary PATH availability and successful claude --version are environment prerequisites; a replay binary cannot establish that installation.

TestClaudeMdExternalIncludes_SubfolderCh.reason: Compares actual Claude session transcripts for approved versus unapproved external CLAUDE.md imports from subfolders. This is provider file-loading/trust behavior, not daemon stdout routing.

TestCodexConversationLive.reason: Codex conversation permission round trips require a Codex executable/JSON-RPC recording boundary, plan-mode confirmation and retained real file absence/creation witnesses; Claude stdio tapes do not apply.

TestCodexQuestionLive.reason: Codex request_user_input and adaptive model fallback need a separate Codex protocol recorder. Preserve surfaced question/answer assertions and current-provider fallback behavior.

TestInteractiveConversationLifecycle.reason: Create/rename/archive/unarchive/delete and disk removal are replayable daemon assertions, but actual conversation creation mints session/conversation identities and may add a child. Add typed identity/process-role support; do not replace create with a preseed and claim creation coverage.

TestInteractiveConversationSystemPrompt_.reason: Two conversations require separate appended system-prompt files and marker isolation. Add session/process-role identity support and complete per-child prompt-file comparison; semantic instruction following stays live.

TestInteractiveSessionErrorRecovery.reason: The helper deliberately starts a failing closed-stdin executable, changes executable selection, observes retained versus dropped queue behavior and recovers a successor. Add explicit child exit/EOF/stderr and multiple-launch lifecycle support.

TestInteractiveStreamBackgroundIdleProbe.reason: Opt-in evidence probe joins turn idle with a physical FIFO reader/rendezvous to determine whether background work is actually alive. Recorded idle cannot establish that physical liveness.

TestInteractiveStreamClearRunsDaemonRese.reason: Reset edges, exactly one transition, stored handoff and successor prompt are useful deterministic claims. Requires predecessor/wrap-up/successor roles, typed session rotation and file-input inventory. Actual predecessor-to-successor recall remains live.

TestInteractiveStreamClearWrapUpSkipped.reason: Skipped wrap-up must preserve a preexisting note and three reset edges. Needs rotation roles plus explicit deadline/clock or cancellation checkpoint; quick replay must not accidentally turn a timed-out wrap-up into a successful one.

TestInteractiveStreamDormantResetAfterRe.reason: Daemon restart, dormant predecessor resume, fresh handoff-note production and successor prompt require daemon/process lifecycle and session-file inputs. Fresh provider recall/read/write witnesses must remain live.

TestInteractiveStreamNewSessionRotatesAn.reason: New-session rotation includes repeated control sends, fresh UUID persistence, transition attribution and actual successor transcript appearance. Requires typed rotation, multiple processes and explicit transcript/file effects; provider transcript production stays live.

TestInteractiveStreamPermissionDenyAfter.reason: Effort update followed by SIGKILL and a confirmed different child PID precedes permission denial. Existing denial driver can be reused only after lifecycle/respawn/source-argument support is added.

TestInteractiveStreamResumeAfterEviction.reason: Idle eviction followed by --resume and token recall requires eviction/child exit, relaunch and transcript input support. Preserve original idle timing and current Claude semantic recall as live obligations.

TestInteractiveStreamRunningTurn.reason: The central assertion is a real minimum responding interval with no idle while a foreground Bash loop still runs. Untimed stdout playback would remove the test purpose; deterministic state-sequence projection is only partial coverage.

TestInteractiveStreamSendFile.reason: Send-file invokes daemon file/MCP side effects which do not occur merely by replaying Claude tool-use/result stdout. Add a causal MCP/control-socket side-channel boundary or independently exercise its real RPC, then preserve attachment bytes and physical capture witnesses.

TestInteractiveStreamStdioAlwaysAllowIsS.reason: Session grant must suppress a second permission yet a fresh independent session must prompt. Add distinct fresh-home/process roles or a reviewed paired-scenario driver; retain first file creation and second touch timestamp as physical live evidence.

TestInteractiveStream_FallbackReplySugge.reason: Suggestion fallback uses the persistent stream plus a separate print-mode Claude invocation. Need multi-invocation argv/EOF/exit/result support and an explicit suggestion-set checkpoint before clear; keep source-producer isolation assertions.

TestRealClaudeAppliedSettingsBeforeFirst.reason: Before-first-turn applied settings are two direct runner arms with independent raw response.applied versus production decoder comparisons. Add a runner-query recorder with explicit file/argv profile, nullable effort and advertised-menu evidence.

TestRealClaudeComposerStopClosedInputKil.reason: Closed stdin must leave held work alive until foreground release, then actually exit and remove its background FIFO reader. These are OS/process/descendant effects, not stdout assertions.

TestRealClaudeComposerStopPreservesBackg.reason: Composer Stop has background and foreground held operations plus an external FIFO release after cancellation. Add causal operator-action checkpoints for holds/release and interrupt input; keep actual surviving background reader/tool completion live.

TestRealClaudeStopBackgroundTaskCompleti.reason: Stop held task can share targeted task identity, accepted stop and terminal stopped/roster removal, but only with a verified stop-control stdin before terminal source boundary. Physical FIFO hold and process termination remain live.

TestRealClaude_APIRetryCapture.reason: Fresh api_retry collector stages an actual upstream endpoint and verifies Claude honored routing; source-shape discovery/absence cannot be refreshed by replay. Existing parser fixture controls are separate offline proof.

TestRealClaude_AllowedToolsEnforcement.reason: Actual Claude --allowed-tools enforcement and absent file plus visible refusal are the primary proof. A fake executable would merely obey the fixture; deterministic adapter policy assertions may be tested separately.

TestRealClaude_AskUserQuestion_CapturesT.reason: Fresh AskUserQuestion capture verifies current Claude tool offering and a real MCP approval call reaching the test socket. Client question delivery already has replay ownership; current provider capability/source discovery stays live.

TestRealClaude_BackgroundHandleTrigger.reason: Opt-in background trigger parameter matrix measures real CLI Bash timeout/background handle behavior and physical execution. It is a source evidence probe, not an unported deterministic daemon assertion.

TestRealClaude_BackgroundReachability.reason: Opt-in PTY reachability probe identifies the actual Claude PID/session and descendant/background process reachability. Playback cannot establish OS reachability.

TestRealClaude_BackgroundReplyCompletion.reason: Late subagent reply completion after foreground result and physical hook release can yield deterministic parser/delivery proof, but needs explicit external release and direct-runner checkpoint support. Existing synthetic replay fixture is partial, not fresh physical proof.

TestRealClaude_BypassApprovalArgv_Probe.reason: Bypass/approval argv probe captures installed Claude/MCP launch behavior across alternate argument arms and diagnoses viability. Replaying the observed answer is not a fresh answer to those provider capability questions.

TestRealClaude_BypassReescalation_Probe.reason: Reescalation probe empirically discriminates applied versus failed current-provider mode transition using raw control/init observations. Source acquisition remains live; stable observed protocol contracts can be shared separately.

TestRealClaude_CacheHitWarmsAcrossRuns.reason: Actual provider cache creation/read input-token warming across two fresh runs is the claim. Recorded usage counters cannot establish a cache hit.

TestRealClaude_CompactingEdges.reason: Compacting rise/fall, full boundary fields, event order and zero parser gaps are deterministic candidates in a direct parser/runner harness. Add that recording profile rather than changing the original event-collector assertions into weaker client frames; compaction effectiveness stays live.

TestRealClaude_CompactionCapture.reason: Fresh compaction source collector primes real context then measures actual Claude /compact frames and nonvacuity. Retained fixture parser checks are offline; current provider shape acquisition is inherently live.

TestRealClaude_ContextUsageCapture.reason: Fresh get_context_usage capture records versioned provider response vocabulary/shape and promotability. Raw source collection is distinct from deterministic parser/query tests; do not count an old capture as fresh compatibility.

TestRealClaude_DroppedLineCapture.reason: Opt-in dropped-line source collector joins raw stdout with physical FIFO liveness at result/teardown. Its fresh producer census and physical liveness cannot be established by fixed tapes.

TestRealClaude_EffortInitCapture.reason: Effort-init collector probes installed Claude argv viability, raw initialize behavior and capture publication. It is source discovery; inherited/explicit applied settings projection is separately listed for a runner harness.

TestRealClaude_ExitPathWhileCommandRuns.reason: PTY exit-path probe measures actual pyry/Claude/command process lifecycle and trailer timing while physical work runs. Current pipe-only playback cannot prove those effects.

TestRealClaude_InBandModeSwitch_Probe.reason: Mode-switch probe chooses modes from actual installed capability inventory and records empirical in-band results/viability across arms. Retain source acquisition; later stable forwarding assertions may be captured separately.

TestRealClaude_InitializeControl_SendPoi.reason: Initialize send-point arms measure current installed Claude control response behavior and publish distinct source fixtures. This capture freshness/argv compatibility purpose remains live despite replayable decoders.

TestRealClaude_MCPStatusCapture.reason: Fresh mcp_status source collector boots healthy and deliberately broken real MCP servers and validates actual status payload vocabulary. A stored status cannot establish current MCP startup compatibility.

TestRealClaude_MCP_CodeGraph.reason: Requires real CodeGraph installation/indexing, healthy MCP integration, account API access and actual tool selection against a seeded symbol. Generic daemon recordings cannot establish that external service chain.

TestRealClaude_MCP_Context7.reason: Requires healthy Context7 MCP and actual provider tool use against its live catalog. Recorded resolution is not current connector compatibility.

TestRealClaude_MCP_Figma.reason: Requires Figma MCP availability/access and actual metadata tool invocation against a configured file. Remains external integration proof.

TestRealClaude_MCP_QMD.reason: Requires live QMD collection availability and provider tool invocation against current local search data; this is environment/MCP integration proof.

TestRealClaude_MalformedStreamJSON.reason: Sends malformed stdin directly to the installed Claude executable and asserts its own timely nonzero exit and parse diagnostic. This tests upstream CLI grammar/error behavior, not daemon parsing of output.

TestRealClaude_MidTurnUserCapture.reason: Multi-arm mid-turn user source collector empirically compares real echo/result behavior and execution timing. Existing send-now replay already shares one causal daemon contract; fresh raw behavior acquisition remains live.

TestRealClaude_OperatorSystemLinesCaptur.reason: Operator-system-lines collector invokes real hooks, command inventory changes and notification triggers and publishes source-shape evidence. Physical trigger nonvacuity/provider source acquisition stays live.

TestRealClaude_ParentToolUseCapture.reason: Fresh parent_tool_use collector needs genuine delegated frames naming the spawning Agent tool and source-shape evidence. Daemon lane projection is an independent replay candidate; do not count source collection twice.

TestRealClaude_PermissionProtocol_Spike.reason: Permission protocol spike is upstream exploratory source capture with alternate raw spawn/EOF behavior and timeout observations, not an unported daemon scenario.

TestRealClaude_PrematureStdinClose.reason: Direct real Claude must complete and exit cleanly after stdin EOF within 60s. A wrapper implementing its own EOF policy would not test the upstream lifecycle contract.

TestRealClaude_ResumeAbsentTranscript.reason: Resume-absent probe contrasts an actual established transcript with a reserved missing identity, real CLI exits and filesystem reads. Its provider resume semantics/file-production finding must stay live; daemon lifecycle recovery is separate.

TestRealClaude_RosterAfterFinishCapture.reason: Roster-after-finish collector uses physical FIFO task setup and current child roster replies after real completion. Its producer freshness and task existence evidence cannot be recreated by fixed stdout.

TestRealClaude_SetModelProbe.reason: Set-model probe derives targets from the live advertised account menu, including unservable/refusal controls, and publishes versioned empirical outcomes. Existing daemon model scenarios do not retire this source probe.

TestRealClaude_SetPermissionMode_InBandP.reason: Set-permission-mode arms empirically compare current provider responses/init modes for control/measurement cases. Retain source acquisition distinct from pool forwarding replay candidates.

TestRealClaude_SigtermMidToolUse.reason: SIGTERM mid-tool test joins a real FIFO-held Bash descendant, flushed session file, process-group death and newline-integrity after signaling. Those OS and producer-file effects require a real process test.

TestRealClaude_StdioPermissionPromptDeny.reason: Direct stdio denial checks current Claude emits a genuine matching ask, confirms its denial and actually avoids the side effect. Daemon permission-deny replay is already separate partial protocol coverage, not this provider enforcement proof.

TestRealClaude_StreamEventCapture.reason: Fresh stream_event capture requires actual partial-message argv and text/tool-input delta source shapes. Parser fixtures are offline, but acquisition/unknown future producer shape remains live.

TestRealClaude_StreamExitPathWhileComman.reason: Headless exit-path probe measures real CLI/pyry process exit and physical command lifetime under background timeout conditions. Replay cannot establish surviving descendants or elapsed exit behavior.

TestRealClaude_SubagentPromptCapture.reason: Fresh delegated-prompt capture verifies current real Agent frame prompts/attribution and publishes source fixtures. Subagent lane delivery can migrate independently; this source capture remains live.

TestRealClaude_TaskNotificationCapture.reason: Task-notification collector uses a real FIFO rendezvous/release and completion timing to acquire actual notification frames. Fixed output cannot prove the physical trigger fired.

TestRealClaude_TeardownLiveness.reason: Teardown rig measures real process/descendant/FIFO liveness after pyry cancellation under PTY or stream execution. It is not an ordinary stdout parser assertion.

TestRealClaude_ToolProgressCapture.reason: Tool-progress collector holds real work long enough for heartbeats, correlates physical rendezvous and validates fresh source marker vocabulary/parser verdicts. Source acquisition and heartbeat timing stay live.

TestRealClaude_ToolResultSidecarCapture.reason: Tool-result-sidecar collector measures current provider sidecar fields from a real file/tool turn. Parser fixture projection may be offline, but fresh provider shape discovery is its purpose.

TestRealClaude_TurnlessSessionIDTranscri.reason: Turnless transcript probe explicitly contrasts real turn-producing versus no-turn children, file presence, live PID and termination. It asks when installed Claude actually creates session JSONL, not how daemon stdout is routed.

TestSuggestCLIFallbackEvidence.reason: Installs deterministic fake claude via installSuggestStandIn and validates fallback observer metadata/exit/privacy over synthetic stdout; no real provider request.

TestSuggestCLIFallbackIncomplete.reason: Deterministic stand-in, controlled pipe saturation and process-group kill verify incomplete observer evidence. Host OS interaction exists, but it is already offline and does not need captured Claude.

TestSuggestCLIProducerIsolation.reason: Writes a local synthetic claude script before installSuggestCLI and verifies native/fallback environment/argv isolation; the conservative provider path is a false positive.

TestSuggestCLISourceEvidence.reason: Synthetic local Claude stdout plus sentinel credentials verify source observer forwarding, counts, privacy and mode 0600; no actual Claude/provider interaction.

TestThreadShadowHistoryCapture.reason: Committed thread_shadow_history.json and thread_shadow_expected.json exist, so the current branch validates/replays those fixtures without Claude. Missing-file fallback is a distinct live capture path with queue/closure checkpoints; retain that explicitly, not as new daemon tape coverage.

TestWithWorktreeAuthenticated_RealAssist.reason: The explicit authentication probe must obtain an actual assistant JSONL response under inherited/OAuth-only disposable HOMEs. Replayed success would defeat the credential authentication claim.

TestWithWorktreeAuthenticated_SkipsAndNa.reason: Re-execs with both credential variables empty and asserts fixture skips/help text. It never launches real Claude.

TestInteractivePerConversationLiveness_A.reason: Dynamic active switching also launches an independent fallback-suggestion print process. Requires complete print argv, EOF, causal input binding and cancellation recording; current prototype rejects that unowned invocation. Original live root remains unchanged.
